description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named ActionBarTabs that demonstrates the use of action bar tabs, including adding, removing, toggling, and handling tab selection events, along with an inner fragment class for tab content.

classes.name: ActionBarTabs
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating the use of ActionBar tabs with functionalities to add, remove, toggle, and remove all tabs, with nested TabListener and fragment classes.

classes.name: TabListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing ActionBar.TabListener to handle tab selection events, managing fragment transactions for each tab.

classes.name: TabContentFragment
classes.description: Inner Fragment class used to display content associated with each tab, showing text based on tab selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides Activity's onCreate to set the activity's layout.

methods.name: onAddTab
methods.description: Adds a new tab to the ActionBar with specified text and a TabListener.

methods.name: onRemoveTab
methods.description: Removes the last tab from the ActionBar if any exist.

methods.name: onToggleTabs
methods.description: Toggles the ActionBar between tab navigation mode and standard mode, also changing display options.

methods.name: onRemoveAllTabs
methods.description: Removes all tabs from the ActionBar.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view for the fragment, setting the displayed text.
